versions.text: (b) (3) Each non-essential APU air intake system which does not comply with CS 25B1093 (b)(2) will be restricted to use in non-ice conditions, unless it can be shown that the APU complete with air intake system, if subjected to icing conditions, will not affect the safe operation of the aeroplane.
